title: Client missions
exampleQuestions: What client missions has he done?
Has he built tools for customers?
answer: Hamza carries out projects through ETIC INSA Technologies, the Junior Enterprise of INSA Lyon. For example, he is building a tool that generates planning documents automatically from a planning software's exports for a French road-construction company, he built the J'ai PiGé educational mobile app, and he is currently building a Python prototype that computes material flows for an environmental and territorial consulting firm, with AI assistants that cite their sources. All are on the Evaluation page.
